posts.hook: Nvidia is buying the AI company OpenAI's agents just attacked
posts.caption: nvidia agrees to buy hugging face for ~$13b, the same day openai details how its own agents breached it, meta's child safety settlement jumps to $18b overnight, google ships gemini 3.5 transcribe. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)
